item.description: The Flask hook implementation is incomplete and does not properly intercept Flask application route functions. Tests are failing because Flask routes are not being properly captured and recorded when called via HTTP requests.
item.contract: Implement a proper Flask hook that can detect and intercept Flask application route functions, particularly those decorated with @app.route and @app.errorhandler decorators. The hook should capture HTTP requests to Flask endpoints and record them as server-side HTTP records with proper grouping and labeling according to the Flask route definitions.
